
```{r}
#| include: true
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("Vs30.target") || !length(Vs30.target)) Vs30.target <- sort(as.numeric(Vs30.gmdp))
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  DEQTable,
  "DEQ_PCE.qmd",
  suffix = ".site",
  target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("Tn.target") || !length(Tn.target)) Tn.target <- 0
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units)) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Post-closure design earthquakes in terms of peak ground acceleration (PGA) [%s] by standard (%s) and consequence class. Values cover AEPs from 1/%d to 1/%d [1/yr] and site conditions with Vs30 from %d to %d [m/s]."
Stage.target <- c("Operation"   , "Closure",      "Post-Closure")
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-deq_pce
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP  |> sprintf(PSA_Units, paste(Standard.target, collapse = ", "), min(TR.target), max(TR.target), min(Vs30.target), max(Vs30.target))

Stage.target <- "Post-Closure"
source(file.path(root,"scripts","tbl/DEQ.R"))
TBL
```


```{r}
#| include: false
rm(ID.target, Tn.target, Vs30.target, TR.target, PSA_Units, Stage.target, CAP)
```
